useCase: Powerlifting meet recap cards and clips from the lifter's OpenPowerlifting CSV row: nine attempts on a 3 x 3 board, good lift or no lift, the bests, the total and the points
who: Powerlifters, coaches and meet directors; they gather at meets, on Instagram and around openpowerlifting.org, which archives every sanctioned meet and gives each lifter a CSV of their results
title: Powerlifting Meet Recap
